question: In the pyrolysis of teak tree leaves, which product's model had the lowest coefficient of variation, and at what temperature and residence time was that product's maximum yield obtained?
expect: bio-gas, C.V. 1.99%; maximum 40.27% at 500 °C and 30 min (p3-4; Table 3)
rendered:
The model for bio-gas yield had the lowest coefficient of variation, which is 1.99%. 

The maximum bio-gas yield of 40.27% was obtained at a pyrolysis temperature of 500 ℃ and at a residence time of 30 minutes.
